question.text: Registration of a new Portfolio Manager is governed by which regulation range?

explanation.text: The Logic: PM Regs 2020: Reg 7 (application), Reg 8 (details), Reg 9 (furnishing further info), Reg 10 (consideration), Reg 11 (grant of certificate) — the registration cluster. The Trap: Other regulations handle other products; PM registration is Reg 7-11 specifically. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B-specific depth (XXI-A Distributors doesn't go this deep). Manager's Pro-Tip: Keep the registration checklist handy for audit — SEBI inspections verify all registration conditions remain satisfied.
